title: Share o8d route states and record bounded request counts
summary: New projects open pull requests by default.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: New projects open pull requests by default. Existing projects keep their merge choice.
Dispatched workers run in the macOS sandbox by default. Set `O8_WORKER_SANDBOX=off` to turn it off.
The composer shows a pull request's checks and its conflicts, and can hand a conflict to an agent.
Reviews show a scorecard and a change map.
Every transcript has a prompt navigator, and worker and reviewer transcripts read like the main one.
A working strip shows what the agent is doing, with a timer, while a turn runs.
An experimental canvas holds saved diff cards. It stays off until you turn on canvas mode.
A publication is tied to the commit that was approved.

sections.title: Performance
items: Re-read a lane's events only when they change
Parse each AI provider transcript once until it changes
Fetch each repository's base at most every 5 minutes
Keep a mission's row when an update changes nothing
Find a packet's mission without parsing every mission
Compile the app shell on all cores
Use an available Rust compiler cache
